Karthik / Marissa — quick legal read. I reviewed the signed MSA and the order form: there is an implied permission for "identification" in marketing collateral, but it is limited and ambiguous as to press releases and quotes. Recommend we send the customer a short acknowledgement agreement rather than treat this as covered. Proposed points below (I also attached tracked changes):

- Preview window: require customer to provide the final press release and any quoted material 5 business days prior to embargo for approval (to ensure no confidential product details leak).
- Logo usage: customer may use Redwood logo only in approved color/lockup variants. We will provide an assets package and a simple credit line: "Redwood Inference — inference platform provider."
- Non-endorsement: include language that customer reference does not imply Redwood endorsement of financial products or investment advice.
- Quote attribution & edits: we can request non-substantive edits for accuracy; substantive changes to purported endorsement require explicit sign-off.
- Limited publicity license: if customer requires broader rights (e.g., perpetual use of excerpted quote in case studies), propose a time-limited license (6 months) unless Legal agrees to longer term after review.
- Embargo exceptions: allow limited internal communications and retailer/trade previews but prohibit distribution to broad media before agreed date.

Rationale: protects confidential roadmap details, keeps brand usage consistent, and gives Marketing time to prepare approved collateral. If the customer pushes back, we can offer a one-time exception for a co-branded case study with additional approvals.

Attachment: MSA_Publicity_Redlines_TRACKED.docx (summary: redlined publicity clauses + suggested customer acknowledgement template)

If useful I can provide a short one-paragraph acknowledgement the Sales team can send to Elena that we already redlined. LMK and I’ll draft.

—Kimberly Park

2) Conditions:
- Please provide the final press release and exact quote copy at least 5 business days before the embargo (by Dec 8).
- Use only the assets and logo variants we supply; do not alter lockups or colors.
- Include the credit line: "Redwood Inference — inference platform provider."
- Any request for broader or perpetual usage (case studies, product marketing) will require a separate limited publicity license; we’ve proposed a 6-month license window in the attached redlines.
- Redwood reserves the right to request non-substantive edits for accuracy; substantive language implying product endorsement must be approved by our legal team.
